tweets.text:
SCALPING BOT TURNED $956 INTO $208,000 on POLYMARKET

Today I find a very cool trader whose PnL on Polymarket is +$208,521

The most interesting thing is that he made a $956 deposit and in 3 months and 1,046 trades turned it into $208,000 of net profit. He made 220x on his deposit in just 3 months!

Here is this guy’s Polymarket account:
https://t.co/8yGxzIxojk

I analyzed each of his trades and it became obvious to me that this is someone’s trading bot and here is why:

> The median interval between trades is 20 seconds

> 25% of trades have a pause of less than 4 seconds

> Many trades are made in the same second

> 890 BUY vs 610 SELL. It is clear that there is active trading and only 31.5% of trades are held until settlement

These are typical patterns for a scalping bot.

This bot trades mainly on the LoL and Dota2 markets. It trades only on three markets:

> Match/series winner (BO3/BO5) - the main bulk. Around $206k volume

> Map winner (Game 1/2/3…) - a lot of trades (scalp/in-play). Around $159k volume

> Less often: total maps (O/U 4.5) and spread (single). A few thousand dollars of volume

But the most important thing here is that about 24% of his trades occur at a price around 90c, 17.5% of trades occur at a price of 99c. At the same time about 9% of trades are made at a price around 1c with the calculation for to the moon.

This bot trades only during games and the point is that it specializes in markets where you can catch an information advantage during the game. As soon as it gets this, it catches the price pump and quickly sells the position, taking profit.

Recently a large number of trading bots have appeared on Polymarket that have increased their deposit hundreds of times. For copy trading these accounts there is a cool trading bot in TG:
https://t.co/JnsNu5osKl
